name: universal_property
statement: 𝒮} {a' : 𝒳} (g : R' ⟶ R) (f' : R' ⟶ S) (hf' : f' = g ≫ f) (φ' : a' ⟶ b) [IsHomLift p f' φ'] : ∃! χ : a' ⟶ a, IsHomLift p g χ ∧ χ ≫ φ = φ'

name: of_comp
statement: IsStronglyCartesian p f φ where universal_property'

have_tree.name: h₁
have_tree.body: by simpa using IsHomLift.comp p (h ≫ f) _ τ ψ

name: isIso_of_base_isIso
statement: a ⟶ b) [IsStronglyCartesian p f φ] [IsIso f] : IsIso φ
